name: component-api-design
description: Use this skill when creating a component or designing its public API — props, slots, emits, v-model, expose — or reviewing whether an existing API is consistent and discoverable.
when: When creating a component or changing its public props, slots, emits, models, expose, or contract
do-not-use-when: Editing component internals without changing its public props, slots, emits, models, or exposed methods
Fixing Vue reactivity, lifecycle, routing, store, or styling issues with no component API decision
Reviewing low-level code style where the public component contract is already settled
